Home.headline: NATURE AND RELAX
Home.subheadline: The Dream of Maremma awaits you for an unforgettable stay.
Home.text: The Dream of Maremma awaits you in the heart of Tuscany, between golden hills, the scents of Mediterranean maquis and sunsets that dye the sky with burgundy. Every stay is an experience that you take with you: carefully designed rooms, a rejuvenating spa, a kitchen that celebrates the territory. A place to really stop.

Services.title: Services
Services.description: Discover the range of services we offer to make your stay unforgettable.
Services.headline: Services tailored to You
Services.text: From the panoramic pool to the rejuvenating spa, from the restaurant that celebrates the flavors of Maremma to the bike rental for exploring the surrounding nature, every service is thought out to give you a unique and unforgettable experience.

pool.title: Pools
pool.headline: A bath of relaxation and beauty
pool.description: Relax in our pools and enjoy the refreshing water in a serene environment.
pool.text:
Our two pools offer moments of relaxation in every season: the indoor pool is open all year round from 8:00 am to 8:00 pm, while the panoramic outdoor pool is available from May to September during the same hours.

 Access is included with your stay and includes sun loungers, umbrellas and towels for guests.
 We recommend reserving a lounger at reception, especially in July and August; the indoor pool is also ideal for a wellness break on cooler days.

spa.title: The spa
spa.headline: Rejuvenate mind and body
spa.description: In our wellness retreat, you can rejuvenate your mind and body with a range of treatments and therapies.
spa.text:
The spa is open from 9:00 am to 7:00 pm and offers relaxing massages, facial treatments and a wellness circuit with sauna, steam room and herbal tea area.

 Treatments last 50 or 80 minutes, with prices starting at €70; the spa circuit costs €35 per person for two hours. Booking is required and can be made at reception at arrival or later.
 To ensure a peaceful experience, access is arranged in time slots and bathrobes are included.

restaurant.title: The restaurant
restaurant.headline: Authentic Maremma flavors
restaurant.description: Savor the flavors of Tuscany with our exquisite cuisine, prepared with fresh and locally sourced ingredients.
restaurant.text:
The restaurant is open for lunch from 12:30 pm to 2:00 pm and dinner from 7:30 pm to 10:00 pm, with a seasonal menu designed for full board stays.

 Every day it offers homemade pasta, local meats, the catch of the day and vegetarian options; the four-course tasting menu costs €55 per person, while à la carte first courses start at €18. Pairings of Maremma wines are available from €25.
 For lunch and dinner, guests are advised to reserve a table at reception and report any allergies or dietary requirements by 10:00 am.

bike.title: The bike rental
bike.headline: Explore Maremma by bicycle
bike.description: Explore the Maremma on a bicycle and discover its breathtaking landscapes.
bike.text:
Discover the most beautiful routes in Maremma by bicycle and enjoy the unspoilt nature of this land. Rent one of our bicycles and set off on an adventure through country roads, vineyards and historic villages! Every rental includes a helmet, lock and a map with recommended routes.

Cost: €15 for half a day, €25 for a full day. Bicycles can be collected and returned at reception; to guarantee availability, we recommend booking the day before.
 For information, customised routes and bookings, please contact us directly at the hotel.

About.headline:
A story of hospitality,
 from 30 years nourished by Maremma
About.text:
Founded in 1987 by a farming family from Siena, Hotel Sogno in Maremma was born from a desire to share the quiet beauty of this land with the world. What was once a country farmhouse surrounded by vineyards and olive groves has evolved over the years into a charming retreat where the spirit of Tuscan tradition permeates every corner. 

Following a renovation completed in 2010, the hotel successfully reinvented itself without losing its soul: original wooden beams, exposed stonework, and terracotta floors now blend seamlessly with refined interiors and modern amenities. Four generations of hospitality, one single promise: to make you feel at home, a home that captures the true essence of Maremma.

Rooms.text: Discover our elegant and comfortable rooms, designed to offer you an unforgettable stay.

economy.name: Economy Room
economy.description: Our Economy Room offers a cozy and comfortable stay with all the essential amenities you need for a relaxing getaway. Perfect for solo travelers or couples, this room provides a budget-friendly option without compromising on quality.

comfort.name: Comfort Room
comfort.description: The Comfort Room is designed for those seeking a balance of comfort and style. With modern furnishings and thoughtful amenities, this room provides a welcoming space for relaxation and rejuvenation during your stay.

deluxe.name: Deluxe Room
deluxe.description: Experience the ultimate in luxury and comfort with our Deluxe Room. Featuring elegant decor, premium amenities, and a spacious layout, this room is perfect for guests looking to indulge in a truly memorable stay.

hottub.name: Hot Tub Suite
hottub.description: Our Hot Tub Suite offers a unique and indulgent experience with a private hot tub for ultimate relaxation. Enjoy the soothing waters and unwind in style, making your stay truly unforgettable.

project.title: An educational project
project.text: This site is a personal, educational project. Hotel Sogno in Maremma does not exist: the property, the services, the prices and the contact details are fictional and serve illustrative purposes only.

images.title: Images and content
images.text: The images used on this site come from two sources: some were downloaded online from freely usable image sites, others were generated with artificial intelligence tools. They are not available under commercial licences.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text: This site does not use cookies, tracking tools or profiling services. No consent is therefore required and no banner is shown.

bookings.title: Booking data
bookings.text: The data entered in the booking form (name, email address, stay dates and party size) is stored temporarily for the sole purpose of being displayed in the admin area. It is kept for a maximum of 30 days from the request and is then automatically deleted. It is not shared with third parties nor used for marketing purposes.

advice.title: A suggestion
advice.text:
Since this is an educational project, please use dummy data. Enter a made-up name and a non-existent email address, and do not share any real personal information.
 The project also includes email confirmation, so insert a valid email address to see it. This is not mandatory and the sent address is not stored and deleted after 30 days.
